extracted.intended_audience: prospective Ph.D. students and stakeholders interested in the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (DOE CSGF)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the DOE CSGF: who the program serves, its objectives, and the kinds of benefits and experiences it provides for doctoral students using high-performance computing. Useful for prospective applicants and institutional partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — doctoral students in HPC-related fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides outstanding financial benefits and professional development opportunities to students pursuing doctoral degrees in fields that use high-performance computing to solve complex science and engineering problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target audience is students pursuing a doctoral degree whose research uses high-performance computing to address complex science and engineering problems. (Original wording: 'students pursuing doctoral degrees in fields that use high-performance computing to solve complex science and engineering problems.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Shared research interest — use of computing in research
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows come from diverse scientific and engineering disciplines but share a common interest in using computing in their research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection/participation implies a demonstrated interest in applying computational methods to scientific/engineering research. (Original wording preserved.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Community character — energetic, committed, impact-oriented
rubrics_metrics.description: The program fosters a community of energetic and committed Ph.D. students, alumni, DOE laboratory staff and other scientists who want to have an impact on the nation while advancing their research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on fellows who will participate actively in a community and are motivated to have national impact as well as advance their own research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program objective — workforce development in computational sciences
rubrics_metrics.description: To help ensure an adequate supply of scientists and engineers appropriately trained to meet national workforce needs, including those of the DOE, in computational sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A key success criterion for the program is producing graduates trained to address national and DOE workforce needs in computational science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program objective — raise visibility and encourage careers
rubrics_metrics.description: To raise the visibility of careers in the computational sciences and to encourage talented students to pursue such careers, thus building the next generation of leaders in the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program evaluates its impact in part by its ability to attract talented students into computational-science career paths and nurture future leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical training — provide cross-disciplinary, team-based lab experience
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide practical work experiences for the fellows that allows them to encounter the cross-disciplinary, team-based, scientific research environment of the DOE national laboratories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program participation includes structured practical experiences (e.g., internships/collaborations at DOE labs) emphasizing cross-disciplinary and team-based research exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration objective — strengthen academic–DOE lab ties
rubrics_metrics.description: To strengthen collaborative ties between the academic community and DOE national laboratories so the fellowship’s multidisciplinary nature builds the national community of scientists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An evaluative aim is fostering sustained collaborations between universities and DOE labs; success includes building a multidisciplinary national scientific community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program offerings — financial benefits and professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Established in 1991, the Department of Energy Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (DOE CSGF) provides outstanding financial benefits and professional development opportunities to students...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship explicitly includes generous financial support and professional-development programming as core components; applicants should expect and may be evaluated relative to these program features.
